regime_read: The strongest measured convergence sits in semiconductors, defense software, pharma, and enterprise AI, but several clusters rely partly on sentiment or qualitative affiliations rather than harder flows. With no completed track-record observations, conviction remains modest and the cleaner reads favor non-extended names where operational or policy channels align with ownership signals.
regime_read_zh: 当前较强的可测聚合集中在半导体、国防软件、制药和企业AI，但部分信号仍依赖情绪或定性关联，而非更硬的资金流证据。由于历史判断尚无到期评分，整体置信度保持克制，更值得关注的是运营或政策信号与持仓信号相互印证、且尚未过度上涨的标的。

theses.thesis: The pack's strongest weighted cluster combines net buying by four congressional members, strongly positive insider purchase pressure, accelerating federal grants, and a sizable patent cluster [congress_cluster] [insider_mspr] [gov_grant_accel] [patent_cluster]. Bullish social sentiment and the Ro Khanna affiliation add breadth but are softer confirmation [stocktwits_bull] [actor:Ro Khanna]. The stock has lagged SPY over 60 days, so the signal is not being chased.
theses.thesis_zh: 该证据包中权重最高的聚合同时包含四名国会议员的净买入、显著为正的内部人买入压力、加速的联邦拨款以及较大的专利集群 [congress_cluster] [insider_mspr] [gov_grant_accel] [patent_cluster]。看多社交情绪和与Ro Khanna的关联扩大了信号覆盖面，但属于较软的印证 [stocktwits_bull] [actor:Ro Khanna]。该股过去60日跑输SPY，因此并非追涨型判断。
second_order: AMAT — memory-capacity investment would support wafer-fabrication equipment demand, with its own congressional and patent signals
Semiconductor equipment — sustained memory investment would transmit into fabrication and process-tool spending
Data-center memory supply chain — tighter high-performance memory demand would benefit upstream components and packaging
theses.dissent: The 60-day relative underperformance may reflect weakening memory fundamentals, while social sentiment and affiliation signals could be noisy.

falsifier.text: Insider purchase pressure reverses while federal-grant acceleration fades and congressional net buying turns neutral or negative.

theses.thesis: Eleven Phase 3 starts and an FDA label-expansion signal align with elevated lobbying activity and a disclosed Trump-linked buy [clinical_phase3_start] [fda_label_expansion] [lobbying] [trump]. The healthcare legislation is only introduced and is not a direct company-specific catalyst, so it adds sector context rather than firm evidence. Four clinical halts and already-strong relative performance keep conviction low.
theses.thesis_zh: 11项III期临床启动和FDA标签扩展信号，与较高的游说活动及披露的特朗普关联买入同时出现 [clinical_phase3_start] [fda_label_expansion] [lobbying] [trump]。医疗法案目前仅处于提出阶段，也并非公司特定催化剂，因此只能提供行业背景，不能作为直接证据。四项临床暂停以及已经较强的相对表现使置信度维持在低位。
second_order: Oncology diagnostics — broader cancer treatment pathways can increase companion-diagnostic demand
Clinical research services — a large late-stage pipeline supports trial-management and laboratory activity
Cancer-care coordination software — proposed Medicare planning coverage could support care-management infrastructure if enacted
theses.dissent: Four clinical halts create a meaningful pipeline-quality counterweight, while the stock is approaching the extended threshold after outperforming SPY.

falsifier.text: Late-stage clinical halts increase or the label-expansion pathway is withdrawn or delayed without offsetting Phase 3 progress.
